title: Leveraging Data Mining, Active Learning, and Domain Adaptation for Efficient Discovery of Advanced Oxygen Evolution Electrocatalysts
summary: A multistage ML and active-learning workflow guided experimental catalyst batches. The journal article reports the best measured overpotential at 10 mA/cm² falling from 209 to 154 mV between batches one and five for sample B; stability rankings differ and mechanism calculations are not independent experimental proof.
ai_technology: Supervised/unsupervised materials models, active learning and domain adaptation
organization: University of Chicago; North China Electric Power University; Nanjing University; The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

evidence.tested: Primary journal record and full-text link identify the reported campaign and experimental catalyst result; arXiv v1 submitted 2024-07-05 already names the Ru–Mn–Ca–Pr catalyst, so journal date is not first disclosure.
evidence.unknown: Independent replication and exhaustive prior-art review are not established.
